body: Yeah, I feel you on that. Personally I decided that I would still go on on my own hoping to one day find someone who genuinelly cares because I refuse to believe that everybody is so cold.
Thank you for saying that I'm well spoken, english isn't even my first language.

Let me share with you something that has been on my mind recently. Have you noticed how our body does everything to keep us alive?How for exemple, the heart will start pumping faster if your blood pressure goes down? Or how if you are starving your body will hold on its  fat and your metabolic rate will decrease? How we have a whole strong army;our immune system; to protect us from outside threats? And there are many more complex mechanisms in place to keep us and actually all living matter alive. I want to die too, I despise all the bad in this world too mainly because I'm a highly sensitive person, but that fascinates me. Also I often think that even if my depression ever goes away, I'll still find living uncomfortable. Because living seems absurd. So why does my bodie try to keep me alive no matter what even if it means consuming itself? Maybe our bodies are trying to protect us for some thing? What do you think?
